title: Two-to-three-year effectiveness and safety of nurse-led accelerated corneal crosslinking for progressive keratoconus: The Birmingham and Midland Eye Centre Study

groups.description: Nurse-led accelerated epithelium-off CXL (8 mm epithelial removal, 0.1% riboflavin with 1.1% HPMC without dextran for 15 min, 365 nm UVA 10 mW/cm2 for 9 min, 5.4 J/cm2) for progressive keratoconus, Birmingham and Midland Eye Centre, February 2019-December 2021; 204 patients were treated, of whom the 97 (one eye each) who completed the 24-month follow-up form the analysis set; 31 of them completed 36 months. Procedure described as cross-linking only.

decision: excluded: no admissible series (both tabulated analysis sets are complete-case subsets)

exclusions.what: Table 2 (Tab2) CDVA, logMAR at baseline, 12 and 24 months, 97 eyes
exclusions.reason: complete-case analysis set: the study included only the 97 of 204 treated patients who completed the 24-month follow-up, which is the last tabulated visit of Table 2 (inclusion: at least a 2-year follow-up); the brief excludes analysis sets restricted to eyes that completed the tabulated visits when the group had more operated eyes

exclusions.what: Table 4 (Tab4) CDVA, logMAR at baseline, 12, 24 and 36 months, 31 eyes
exclusions.reason: complete-case subset: the 31 eyes that completed the 36-month follow-up out of the 97-eye cohort

exclusions.what: Table 1 (Tab1) presenting CDVA and proportions by CDVA category

exclusions.reason: proportions and lines are not admissible
